```plato
    //==
    // # Frame and basis operations
    //
    // Matrix interchange between the coordinate frames of `transforms.types.plato`
    // and the rigid poses they are equivalent to, plus the basis of a rotation.

    //==
    // Frames and bases — orthonormal frames are rigid poses in matrix-friendly
    // clothing: the axes are the rotation, the origin is the translation.

    // The affine matrix mapping frame-local coordinates to world coordinates
    // (axes become the linear rows, the origin the translation row).
    Matrix3x2(f: Frame2D): Matrix3x2
        => (Number2(f.XAxis.Vector.X, f.XAxis.Vector.Y),
            Number2(f.YAxis.Vector.X, f.YAxis.Vector.Y),
            Number2(f.Origin.X, f.Origin.Y));
```

```plato
    // The affine matrix of the pose (rotation, then translation).
    Matrix3x2(pose: Pose2D): Matrix3x2
        => pose.Rotation.Matrix3x2 * Matrix3x2.CreateTranslation(pose.Position.PositionVector);
```

```plato
    //==
    // Rotation matrices — 2D rotations embed in Matrix3x2, 3D rotations in
    // Matrix4x4. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix

    // The affine matrix of a plane rotation about the origin.
    Matrix3x2(r: Rotation2D): Matrix3x2
        => Matrix3x2.CreateRotation(r.Angle);
```

```plato
    // The affine matrix of the transform: S * R * T in row-vector order.
    Matrix3x2(t: TrsTransform2D): Matrix3x2
        => Matrix3x2.CreateScale(t.Scale) * t.Rotation.Matrix3x2
            * Matrix3x2.CreateTranslation(t.Translation);
```
